description: A false-colour infrared aerial or satellite image depicting a landscape dominated by vegetation. Dense, healthy vegetation, likely forest or dense scrub, is rendered in dark red and deep brown hues. Two irregularly shaped areas are delineated by bright green outlines. Within these green-outlined parcels, the land cover consists of lighter, mottled tones including pale green, yellowish, and reddish-pink patches, indicative of less dense vegetation or recently disturbed ground, consistent with semi-natural grasslands or areas from which scrub has been removed. Scattered darker points within these lighter patches suggest remaining individual trees or shrubs. A small, distinct patch of light blue-green appears in the upper right, potentially indicating water or bare ground. This image illustrates Mediterranean grassland areas, such as those that might be ploughed periodically to manage scrub invasion.
